The Sure Thing.
What is the Sure Thing?
What can make you know what the Sure Thing is?
Thamud and Ad said the Great Shock was a lie.
As for Thamud, they were destroyed by a great blast.
As for Ad, they were destroyed by a strong, roaring wind.
Allah sent it on them for seven nights and eight days. You could see the people lying there, like trunks of old palm trees.
Can you see anyone left of them?
Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the people of the towns that were turned upside down. They all did wrong.
They did not obey the messenger of their Lord, so He took them with a strong grip.
When the water rose high, We carried you in the sailing ship.
We did it to make it a lesson for you, so that ears that remember can remember it.
Then when the horn is blown one time.
And the earth and the mountains are lifted and crushed with one crush.
On that Day the great event will happen.
And the sky will split open, and on that Day it will be weak.
And the angels will be at its edges. Eight angels will carry the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.
On that Day you will be shown. No secret of yours will stay hidden.
As for the one who is given his book in his right hand, he will say: Here, take my book and read it!
I knew I would be asked about what I did.
So he will have a happy life.
In a high garden.
Its fruit is close enough to reach.
Eat and drink happily for what you did in the days before.
But as for the one who is given his book in his left hand, he will say: I wish I had never been given my book!
And never known what my account was.
If only death had ended it all.
My money did not help me.
My power is gone.
Take him and tie him up.
Then burn him in the Fire.
Then tie him in a chain that is seventy arms long.
He did not believe in Allah the Great.
And he did not tell others to feed the poor.
So today he has no friend here.
And no food except dirty stuff.
Only people who did wrong eat it.
I swear by what you see.
And by what you do not see.
This is the word of a great messenger.
It is not the word of a poet. You hardly believe.
And it is not the word of a fortune teller. You hardly think about it.
It is a message sent down from the Lord of all.
If he had made up some words and said they were from Us.
We would have taken him by his right hand.
Then We would have cut the vein of his heart.
And none of you could have kept Us away from him.
This is a reminder for people who fear Allah.
And We know that some of you will say it is a lie.
And it will be a great sadness for people who said no.
But it is the absolute truth.
So praise the name of your great Lord.
